brief: Luminous tendrils of steam rise and curl across the canvas, weaving together abstract forms that coalesce into stable, glowing glyphs. These glyphs do not remain stable, but rather begin to dissolve. As they break apart, they transform into glowing particulate matter that drifts and accumulates. This dispersed matter momentarily organizes itself into transient, crystalline geometries which shimmer before gently drifting away and dissipating completely. The entire process is a continuous, ethereal display of formation, stabilization, and dissolution, creating a living, breathing artwork of vanishing language.

statement: This sketch depicts an ethereal, ever-shifting landscape of glowing forms that emerge from and dissolve back into swirling steam. Particles coalesce into stable, luminous glyphs that slowly rotate on their vertical axis before dissolving into fragmentary matter. This transformed material briefly organizes itself into shimmering crystalline structures which then drift away and vanish entirely. The visual rhythm captures a continuous cycle of formation, stabilization, and dissolution, creating an ever-changing tapestry of vanishing language that breathes with life.
